title: Reflection on Teacher Judgment
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting reflection on teacher judgment to a decision log, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Convert a feelings paragraph into a decision log with one row per AI suggestion (situation, what the AI said, decision, reason)
Judge whether a reason is defensible by testing if it points to a standard a reader could re-apply, rather than a mood
Distinguish ACCEPT, OVERRIDE, and REJECT, and log a rejected unrequested AI addition
Read the accept/override ratio as evidence of weighing rather than blanket trust or contrarianism

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
